ALLOWED_CATEGORIES = ["Electronics", "Accessories", "Furniture", "Office Supplies"]

def clean(df):
    d = df.copy()
    # normalize Category labels (whitespace / case variants -> canonical allowed values)
    cat = d["Category"].astype("string").str.strip().str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True)
    canon = {c.lower(): c for c in ALLOWED_CATEGORIES}
    d["Category"] = cat.map(lambda x: canon.get(str(x).lower(), x) if x is not None and str(x) != "<NA>" else x)
    # numeric coercion
    d["Quantity"] = pd.to_numeric(d["Quantity"], errors="coerce")
    d["Price"] = pd.to_numeric(d["Price"], errors="coerce")
    # enforce Revenue = Quantity * Price
    d["Revenue"] = d["Quantity"] * d["Price"]
    return d

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=["Category"])
    g = d.groupby("Category", dropna=True)["Revenue"].sum()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
